movie.title: This Is Not a Test
movie.overview: Sloane and four classmates take cover in Cortege High to escape a world plagued by the infected. As danger relentlessly pounds on the doors, Sloane begins to see the world through the eyes of those who actually want to live and takes matters into her own hands.

reviews.author: Manuel São Bento
reviews.content:
Full review: https://fandomwire.com/this-is-not-a-test-review/

Rating: D

"This Is Not a Test is a deeply frustrating experience that collapses under the weight of its own technical shortcomings and narrative shortcuts. While it begins with the visceral energy of a promising survival horror flick, the movie quickly dissolves into a disjointed series of scenes marred by erratic editing, unmotivated character conflicts, and a screenplay that fails to breathe life into its central themes of hope, trauma, and resilience. Despite Olivia Holt's earnest efforts to ground the story, the lack of a cohesive structural logic makes it impossible to connect with the protagonist's journey from despair to survival. Ultimately, it's a missed opportunity to explore the human psyche against a bleak backdrop."

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
This works, sort of
This is not a great movie, but it builds tension, stays in mostly a single location without feeling cheap, introduces scares and develops characters along the way. The casting is solid, and the direction is good. It is by no means extraordinary, but it has zombies, the zombies are scary, the protagonists are human and act pretty much like humans would, and while this might be forgettable, it is certainly not bad.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Trapped inside Cortege High during a sudden apocalyptic outbreak, a suicidal high school student must navigate the claustrophobic terror of infected monsters outside and volatile human dynamics within.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When a sudden outbreak turns the population into violent, frantic infected, teenager Sloane and four of her classmates lock themselves inside Cortege High to survive. While her peers desperately cling to life and attempt to fortify their sanctuary, Sloane struggles with a deep-seated numbness and a past desire to die. As supplies thin and the infected relentlessly batter the doors, exposure to her classmates' raw will to live forces Sloane to re-evaluate her own existence. She must ultimately step up and take control of her destiny to protect the group before the school's defenses crumble.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The world descends into chaos as a horrifying infection transforms ordinary people into relentless, predatory monsters. Seeking immediate shelter, high schooler Sloane and four fellow students retreat into the sealed corridors of Cortege High. Cut off from the outside world, the group is forced to improvise defenses, manage dwindling resources, and endure the agonizing uncertainty of whether help will ever arrive. Tensions escalate rapidly as fear, grief, and differing coping mechanisms ignite sharp conflicts among the teenagers inside their concrete haven. Sloane, who secretly entered the disaster indifferent to her own survival, initially views the unraveling nightmare with detachment. However, witness to her classmates' fierce determination to survive despite overwhelming odds slowly alters her perspective. The constant threat of breach forces the group to make harrowing choices about trust, sacrifice, and who they can afford to save. As the infected breach the outer barriers, internal panic threatens to tear the sanctuary apart from within. Forced into a corner, Sloane shed her apathy, takes matters into her own hands, and fights back not just for survival, but to preserve the lives of the peers who taught her how to value her own.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of a violent, apocalyptic infection that spreads rapidly across the region, 'This Is Not a Test' follows Sloane and four of her high school peers who find themselves trapped together inside Cortege High School. As the infected surround the building, the teenagers transform their school into a makeshift fortress, struggling to endure both the terrifying threats outside the doors and the mounting psychological pressure within. While the group grapples with dwindling supplies, fear, and personal clashes, Sloane faces an internal battle against her own emotional numbness, ultimately discovering a newfound resolve to survive as the danger reaches its peak.
